about: Reaction graphics library for The Ledger. Style B (linocut), brand palette, transparent background. Original characters only. Never put text inside an image: overlay numbers and captions in HTML.

characters.clerk: The Clerk: deadpan newsprint clerk with a red eyeshade. Main reactor.
characters.sword: The Sword: unimpressed sentient Sword. Lore cameos only.
characters.reticle: The Reticle: the target mark with a face. Emblem and lock-on stories.
